components.name: sbomscope-frontend
components.description: React UI. Vite writes its production build straight into target/classes/META-INF/resources, so packaging this module as a jar makes the whole UI available on the backend's classpath. Spring Boot serves static content from META-INF/resources automatically, which is what lets one jar contain both.
